# Case Studies

Real exploits, re-derived as exercises for the methodology. Each file follows
[`TEMPLATE.md`](TEMPLATE.md); its Summary block names the checklist categories and item IDs that
would have caught the bug, and the build script links every case study into the
[checklist](../../methodology/checklist.md) and the
[reference](../../methodology/checklist-reference.md) next to those items. Reproductions point at
[DeFiHackLabs](https://github.com/SunWeb3Sec/DeFiHackLabs) Foundry tests.

How to use them: pick one, read only the **Background** section, try to find the bug in the
protocol's code yourself, then read the rest. Add a new case study whenever a checklist item
fails to explain an incident you read about: that is a gap in the checklist, and the
"Lessons for the checklist" section is where the new question gets proposed.
